blocks.content: The first passenger train in India ran between Bombay and Thane on 16th April 1853 covering a distance of 34 kilometers.

items: South Coast Railway (SCoR), headquartered at Visakhapatnam, is designated as the 18th Railway Zone of India.
The first electric train ran in India on 3rd February 1925 between Bombay VT and Kurla.
UNESCO World Heritage mountain railways include Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, Nilgiri Mountain Railway, and Kalka-Shimla Railway.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: India's first passenger train operated between Bombay (Bori Bunder) and Thane on 16th April 1853.
Lord Dalhousie is known as the 'Father of Indian Railways'.
The official mascot of Indian Railways is 'Bholu', an elephant dressed as a train guard holding a green signal lamp.
Indian Railways network is divided into 18 administrative zones for efficient operational management.
